hub.title: Settings
hub.intro: All clinic configuration in one place. Routes are unchanged; duplicates were removed from the side menu.

subscription.title: Platform subscription
subscription.intro: See which options are on for your organization, and current catalog prices. Online payment on the public site is for new clinic registration; upgrading an existing organization goes through the platform operator until owner self-service exists.

capabilities.noOrgBody: This clinic is not linked to a platform organization, so SaaS plan limits are not shown here.
capabilities.title: Platform subscription and capabilities
capabilities.enforced: Admin sections outside your plan are hidden. Staff access is still configured in Access rights and policies.
capabilities.compat: Compatibility mode: plan option limits are not applied (box edition or an organization without entitlement records). Control is through roles and permissions.
capabilities.noKeys: No recognized keys in the session — check organization provisioning.
capabilities.upgradeHint: To expand the set, upgrade with the platform (catalog and contacts are on the pricing page).

core_base.title: Product base
core_base.hint: Bookings, patients, schedule, prepayment, notifications, basic reports

crm_pipeline.title: CRM and pipeline
crm_pipeline.hint: Deals, sales, pipeline as the product interprets them

tasks_kanban.title: Tasks and Kanban
tasks_kanban.hint: Task boards for the clinic team

omni_embed_bundle.title: Embedding (embed)
omni_embed_bundle.hint: Booking widget, API keys, site-embed scenarios

embed.title: Embedding (embed)
embed.noOrgBody: The session has no organization_id (typical for a legacy install or before SaaS provisioning). This section is available after the administrator is linked to an organization with the omni.embed.bundle option.
embed.noEntitlementBody: The omni.embed.bundle entitlement is required for the organization.
embed.viewOnlyBody: Issuing and revoking keys and rotating the webhook require manage_embed_settings (owners have it by default).
embed.webhookHint: URL for external channels (Bitrix24 and others). After issuing the secret, send it as Authorization: Bearer.
embed.sigHint: Optional: X-Embed-Signature: v1=<hmac_sha256_hex> over the raw body (same key as Bearer). Hard requirement is env EMBED_WEBHOOK_SIGNATURE_REQUIRED.
embed.keysHint: The token is shown once at creation. Format dceb.<id>.<secret>.
embed.revokeConfirm: Revoke this key? Integrations using it will stop working.
embed.saveTokenBody: This token will not be shown again. Copy it now.
embed.saveSecretBody: The secret is shown once. Set it on the channel as Bearer.
embed.noWebhookUrl: Webhook URL appears after the inbound route is provisioned.
embed.createFailed: Could not create the API key
embed.rotateFailed: Could not rotate the webhook secret

rag.title: Knowledge base (RAG, per-org)
rag.needOrg: An organization link and the ai.rag.org_kb plan option are required.
rag.needEntitlement: The ai.rag.org_kb plan option is required for the organization.

export.title: Data export
export.ownerOnly: This section is available only to the organization owner role.
export.needOrg: Link an organization to the administrator to see the summary.
export.manifestHint: JSON Lines: organization and clinics; for a full PII export use the request below and OPS process.
export.requestOk: Request registered. Operations will prepare the export under the internal process.

ai.title: AI and assistant
ai.pickClinic: Select a clinic in the header first.

status.fallback_local: AI is in local mode (hints without an external provider).

ai.statusHint: With external AI you get detailed conversation summaries, reply hints, patient overviews, and conflict reports. Local mode uses simplified hints without calling an external provider.
ai.statusUnavailable: AI status is unavailable (server or network). Clinic settings below can still be edited.
ai.assistantHint: Modes and scenarios for patient chat and admin hints.
ai.modeHint: Drafts, safe auto-reply, or analytics only
ai.promptHint: Briefly describe what you do, how to address clients, and what not to promise.
ai.intentsHint: Used only in safe auto-reply mode.
ai.scheduleLater: Detailed auto-reply hours/days will be added later. For now AI uses only the selected scenario types.

forms.title: Forms and documents
forms.templatesHint: Manage digital questionnaires and consents. Active templates are available in the PWA and via links.
forms.emptyHint: Create the first questionnaire or consent template to send to patients.
forms.submissionsHint: History of completed forms linked to patients and visits.
forms.schemaHint: Field list with id, label, type, required, options, sensitive
forms.needCodeName: Enter a template code and name

agreements.title: Agreements
agreements.hint: The personal-data agreement is shown at registration. Allowing registration without mailing consent controls whether the second checkbox is required.
agreements.allowWithoutMailingHint: Off — the patient cannot finish registration without the mailing checkbox. On — they can register without mailing.

emergency.title: Announcement wall
emergency.saveCommentFailed: Could not save the comment. Try again.
emergency.deleteCommentFailed: Could not delete the comment. Try again.
emergency.replyAnyone: Reply to everyone or someone specific
emergency.composeHint: By default every staff member will see it. You can limit the audience after clicking Publish.
emergency.emptyHint: Published work announcements will appear here.

notify.title: Notification policy
notify.hint: If a switch is off, the patient cannot turn off that notification type in the app; changes go through the clinic.
notify.discounts: The client may turn off discount and promotion alerts
notify.reminders: The client may turn off appointment reminders
notify.all: The client may turn off all notifications

styling.title: Appearance
styling.hint: These settings apply to the patient app: header, buttons, cards. The logo is shown in the app header instead of the default name. One font is used for the whole app (headings and body).
styling.primaryLabel: Primary color (--primary variable, hex or CSS)
styling.primaryHint: Overrides button and header color in the patient app
styling.logoHint: Shown in the patient app header
styling.fontHint: One font for the whole patient app

stickers.title: Stickers
stickers.hint: A built-in sticker set is used. In chat (patient and admin) a Sticker button sends a sticker as a message.
stickers.coming: A custom sticker set (uploading your own images) will be available in a later version.

knowledge.title: Knowledge base
knowledge.hint: Articles by role; visibility is set when creating.
knowledge.emptyHint: Add playbooks and instructions for the team.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.csvBody: Schedule import and CSV export of closed bookings are available in Schedule and in reports. The export is suitable for loading into 1C.
integrations.oneCHint: API URL and key for future 1C sync. Settings are stored encrypted.
integrations.keyPlaceholder: Leave empty to keep the stored key
integrations.bitrixHint: API connection is planned for later versions. CSV and 1C integration are available now.
